nodes.name: Build Career Search Requests
nodes.notes: Editable seed list of Greenhouse, Lever, and Ashby career-board tokens is in this Code node. Expand the arrays to discover more company career pages. Invalid/unavailable boards are skipped.

nodes.name: Fetch Public Feeds and Company Career Pages
nodes.notes: Uses public APIs only. Missing or invalid ATS board slugs are ignored. Remotive should not be called more than a few times a day.

nodes.name: Normalize and Prefilter Jobs
nodes.notes: New version keeps a company career-page directory and all classification buckets so a strict filter never hides all companies.

parameters.jsCode: const r=$('Assemble Entry-Level Job Report').first().json;const target=Number(r.filters_applied?.experienceMaxYears??1);return [{json:{report_saved:true,report_path:'D:\\job-agent\\entry-level-job-report.json',target_experience:`0-${target} years max`,filters_applied:r.filters_applied,sources_attempted:r.search_scope?.requests_attempted||0,company_career_boards_attempted:r.search_scope?.company_career_boards_attempted||0,jobs_classified:r.results_summary?.jobs_classified||0,confirmed_matches:(r.confirmed_jobs||[]).length,likely_entry_level_review:(r.likely_entry_level_jobs_for_manual_verification||[]).length,manual_experience_review:(r.other_jobs_requiring_experience_review||[]).length,company_career_page_links:(r.company_career_pages||[]).length,top_jobs_to_review:[...(r.confirmed_jobs||[]),...(r.likely_entry_level_jobs_for_manual_verification||[]),...(r.other_jobs_requiring_experience_review||[])].slice(0,25).map(j=>({company:j.company,title:j.title,experience_tier:j.experience_tier,experience_evidence:j.experience_evidence,match_score:j.role_relevance_score,location:j.location,application_url:j.application_link,official_career_page:j.company_career_page,source:j.source_name})),first_20_company_career_pages:(r.company_career_pages||[]).slice(0,20).map(c=>({company:c.company,career_page_url:c.career_page_url,api_status:c.api_status,jobs_returned:c.jobs_returned})),submission_status:'NOT_SUBMITTED'}}];

const report = $('Assemble Entry-Level Job Report').first().json;
return [{ json: report }];
